title: SQL Injection
explanation: User input reaches the database query without proper parameterization.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Never build SQL queries directly from user input.

title: Hardcoded Secret
explanation: A credential appears to be stored directly in code and may be exposed.
remediation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secure secrets manager. Remove secrets from source code and rotate exposed credentials.

title: Outdated Dependency
explanation: A package version contains known vulnerabilities and should be updated.
remediation: Upgrade the dependency to a secure version and verify compatibility through testing.
